sources.title: PMC nalla (storm-water drain) network
sources.license: Public Domain per OpenCity CKAN metadata (no upstream dedication)

provenance.note: 3075 nalla segments totalling 1014 km of open storm-water drain across the PMC area. Chosen over the same dataset's 141,341-segment buried pipe register, which is too dense to render and answers a maintenance question rather than a flooding one. Segment lengths are computed from the geometry and agree with PMC's own st_length_ column to 0.43%, which is a check on the geometry rather than a restatement of it. NO SEGMENT IS NAMED in the source, so Ambil Odha and the other nallas the flood reporting is about cannot be identified from this layer.

_source: PMC Nalla Map (KML) via OpenCity, same dataset page as the SWD register

summary._note: length_km is computed from the shipped geometry; length_km_stated_by_pmc is the sum of the source's own st_length_ column, computed in PMC's projected CRS. They are reported separately on purpose - agreement between them is the evidence the geometry survived conversion.
